title: Evolved Policy Gradients
summary: We’re releasing an experimental metalearning approach called Evolved Policy Gradients, a method that evolves the loss function of learning agents, which can enable fast training on novel tasks. Agents trained with EPG can succeed at basic tasks at test time that were outside their training regime, like learning to navigate to an object on a different side of the room from where it was placed during training.
body: We’re releasing an experimental metalearning approach called Evolved Policy Gradients, a method that evolves the loss function of learning agents, which can enable fast training on novel tasks. Agents trained with EPG can succeed at basic tasks at test time that were outside their training regime, like learning to navigate to an object on a different side of the room from where it was placed during training.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布了名为“进化策略梯度”（Evolved Policy Gradients）的元学习方法。该方法通过进化学习智能体的损失函数，使其能够快速适应新任务。实验表明，经过该方法训练的智能体在面对训练集之外的陌生任务时，表现出更强的泛化与执行能力。
